scores.evidence: Why now: if the document model doesn't converge, nothing built later will work.
scores.rationale: Phases build substrate upward (decisions, editor, convergence proof, sync, persistence, auth, features) with each proven before the next.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Single-user editor ... Basic save/load from local storage or a stub API
scores.rationale: No thin end-to-end production path first; the first build phase is a local editor and nothing is deployed until much later.

scores.evidence: Recommended: a CRDT ... Choose [OT] only if you need strict server authority or already have OT experience.
scores.rationale: Irreversible choices (CRDT vs OT, editor, schema, scope) are up front with defaults and conditions for the alternative, though flip triggers are not stated for all.

scores.evidence: Why first: it tests the schema and editor choice without the complexity of networking.
scores.rationale: Widest-impact items like schema and convergence come first, but ordering within phases is not explicit.

scores.evidence: Why here: permissions shape the protocol and the storage layer. Adding them after launch is painful and risky.
scores.rationale: Security is concentrated in Phase 5 and Phase 11, with only rate limits and size limits in Phase 3; the early phases 0–2 have none.

scores.evidence: Observability: sync latency, message rates, document size, reconnect rates, and divergence detection
scores.rationale: Observability is first scheduled in Phase 9, late, with only a note that monitoring can start once there is a server.

scores.evidence: The fuzz test passes thousands of randomized runs in CI.
scores.rationale: CI and a regression suite are mentioned, but reproducible environments, builds and seeds are not threaded through the phases.

scores.evidence: Reconnect with exponential backoff and jitter
scores.rationale: Resilience shows up in Phases 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9 (flaky network tests, durability, reconnect), but is absent in others and chaos testing comes last.
The plan never says whether an AI layer applies, so the non-AI declaration is missing.

scores.evidence: Scope of v1. Write down what's out, for example comments, suggestion mode and tables.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed, including Phase 10 features in priority order, but there are no pull-forward conditions.

note: The plan has a strong technical sequence, with convergence proven first and decisions up front. It lacks a walking skeleton, observability from day zero, threaded security and reproducibility, and any statement on the AI layer.
